aboutTitle: About the Custom Backpack Capacity Tool
aboutIntro: A larger backpack is essential for many 7 Days to Die players. Frequent game updates, however, can mean searching for, downloading, and replacing a mod again and again. This tool aims to make that process a simple set of choices.
aboutFreedomBody: Choose the total number of slots and the starting unencumbered slots. The tool calculates the layout, interface sizing, and Pack Mule bonuses, with a live preview.
aboutInstallBody: Select your game installation to generate and install the mod in one click, or export a ZIP to keep or share. When you want different settings, just generate it again.

previewModeDescription: Uses markers to clearly show the extra slots provided by an equipped backpack.
gameModeDescription: Simulates how your backpack looks in the game.
detailsSummary: Character: %1 slots · Starting unencumbered: %2 · Large quality-6 backpack: +%3
detailsPerkNote: Each rank increase adds directly to the total unencumbered allowance; skill total is the cumulative bonus. Equipping a backpack only changes visible capacity. Both modes unlock slots in order. Character and backpack columns are calculation shares.
detailsBackpackNote: Each quality scales using its vanilla ratio to the 48-slot large quality-6 backpack, rounded to a whole slot. These values are additional slots.
detailsEquipmentNote: 40 extra slots of headroom remain for clothing and pocket mods when equipped. They are excluded from Pack Mule calculations and this preview.
